**No orders placed — no rule fired.**

Here's what I checked and why each rule stayed silent:

- **R1 (sell robotics basket if it falls >40% today):** The only robotics prints in the feed were intraday `quote_change` snapshots from three venues (VenueA/B/C) at 09:40–09:42: ISRG −0.72% / −1.10% / −1.61%, ROK −1.20% / −1.54% / −0.69%, TER −1.68% / −0.66% / −1.15%. All three venues agree on direction (mildly down) but the magnitude is ~1–2%, nowhere near the 40% threshold. Current broker quotes confirm the basket is essentially flat-to-slightly-down (ISRG $520.40, ROK $268.15, TER $104.60). Threshold not met.
- **R2 (buy $10,000 AAPL on a confirmed takeover offer above market):** The feed contains no corporate-action, exchange-notice, or headline item of any kind relating to AAPL — no bid, no offer, no rumor. AAPL is quoted at $222.70 with no news catalyst. No offer exists, so nothing to confirm across two venues.
- **R3 (sell all MSFT if it falls >15% today):** MSFT's three venue prints at 09:43 were *positive*: +0.29% (VenueA), +0.44% (VenueB), +0.64% (VenueC), and the current quote is $420.18, down only ~0.3% on the day. The two-venue confirmation standard is met for direction, but the direction is up, not down 15%. Threshold not met.

The rest of the feed was ~90 AMZN quote updates and repetitive low-information AMZN headlines ("estimates unchanged," "supplier checks steady," "little changed") — AMZN is outside the mandate, so I ignored it entirely. Account is unchanged: $50,000 cash, 100 MSFT, 20 ISRG, 40 ROK, 100 TER. I placed no orders, so no reported financial figures were required in `key_figures`; had a rule fired, I would have pulled the relevant SEC-filed figures before submitting.
